name: Moto Guzzi V85 TT
engine: 853 cc air-cooled transverse V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Guzzi's retro adventure bike. Air-cooled V-twin, shaft drive and spoked wheels.

H: Guzzi V-twins need the valves set and the throttle bodies or carbs balanced together. Do both at the same service.

recallNote: Moto Guzzi has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
